title: LOCALVALUEBENCH: A Collaboratively Built and Extensible Benchmark for Evaluating Localized Value Alignment and Ethical Safety in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper's core purpose is to evaluate the ethical safety and value alignment of LLMs. It defines a novel typology for ethical reasoning, includes a scoring category for 'Ethical Reasoning' in its evaluation rubric, and benchmarks model performance on morally and socially sensitive topics such as capital punishment and marriage equality.
